title: Nea Wɔabɔ Ne Din wɔ Nkɔmhyɛni no Fie
intro: Wɔ ɔbɔfo a otwa to no fie no, na ɔkra bi te ase a n’ankasa asɛm bɛyɛɛ ɔsoro asuade maa agyidifo nyinaa. Na saa onipa yi asetra ne ahyɛde bi a ɛsakra nnipa a ɛsan hyehyɛɛ asetra mu amanne daa, na ɛhyɛɛ nsakrae kɛse a ɛbae wɔ sɛnea gyidi bɛkyerɛkyerɛ abusua ne ne muni mu agyirae no ho kɛse.
clues: Bere bi na wɔde me din bata abusua a ɛkorɔn ho, nanso akyiri yi na nokware a ɛkorɔn no bɛma gyidi hama ankasa no mu ada hɔ.
Na me nsa kaa adom kesee firi Allah ne Ne somafoa no ho, adom a wodaa no dawuro baguam wo Nwoma no mu.
M’aware asetra bɛyɛɛ sɔhwɛ titiriw a ɛbɛsakra adwene a nkurɔfo kura wɔ abusuabɔ a wɔagye wɔn ayɛ wɔn mma ho koraa.
Na me na m’ankasa n’asɔhwɛ no maa ɔnyaa ɔsoro ahyɛdeɛ a ɛmaa Nkɔmhyɛni no kwan sɛ ɔbɛware ɔbaa wɔ me kɔ akyi.
Ɛdenam m’asɛm so no, wɔmaa nsonsonoe a ɛda abusua a wɔwoo wɔn ne abusua a wɔapaw ntam no daa adi pefee maa awo ntoatoaso nyinaa.
Me nko ara ne m’atipɛnfoɔ mu a ne din pue pefee wɔ adiyisɛm a ɛtwa toɔ no mu, ɛnyɛ sɛ nkɔnhyɛni, na mmom sɛ akoa a wɔasɔ no ahwɛ na wɔahyɛ no anuonyam.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
